story.opened: 2002, when Kate MacGarry founded the gallery in east London.
story.then: The gallery has grown to represent more than 25 artists, including two estates. It works from 27 Old Nichol Street, in a space designed by the architect Tony Fretton.
story.now: Open Tuesday to Saturday, with an exhibition running from 2 October to 14 November 2026.
worth_knowing: The Old Nichol Street space was designed by the British architect Tony Fretton.
The gallery's artists have shown at institutions including MoMA, Tate, the Barbican and the Walker.
The gallery helped found the Gallery Climate Coalition (set up in 2020 to promote environmental sustainability) and is still an active member.
